announcements.text: Conti Federal Services LLC, Orlando, Florida, was awarded a $74,787,155 firm-fixed-price contract, with a total cumulative face value of $74,978,377. Bids were solicited via the internet with three received. Work will be performed in Whiteman Air Force Base, Missouri, with an estimated completion date of Sept. 25, 2029.
